_doc: ADR 0154, read by Dams. hold: how many cells of water head one cell of this material holds per cell of dam thickness (a 1-block = 4-cell dirt wall holds 12 cells = 1.5 m). Materials not listed (stone, cobble, bricks, logs, metal) never wash out and back any run they are in. seep_load: from this load on a dam weeps now and then and holds; at 1 it creaks and seeps for a warning time from warn_max_s (load 1) down to warn_min_s (load 3), then breaks.
